moves.label: Trade: Bones Hyland, Thomas Bryant, Bones Hyland, Davon Reed, Patrick Beverley and others
moves.description: Bones Hyland was acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for a 2024 2nd round pick (LAC own), a 2025 2nd round pick (LAC own) and a TPE. Thomas Bryant and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Denver Nuggets in exchange for Bones Hyland, Davon Reed and a 2024 2nd round pick (DEN own). Patrick Beverley, a 2024 2nd round pick (DEN own) and cash were acquired by the Orlando Magic in exchange for Mo Bamba. Mo Bamba, Davon Reed, a 2024 2nd round pick (LAC own), a 2025 2nd round pick (LAC own) and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for Patrick Beverley, Thomas Bryant and cash.
